main_statement.paraphrase: Tingley's problem (1987) has a positive answer in full generality: the metric of the unit sphere determines a real Banach space up to linear isometry, and every onto sphere isometry is the restriction of a unique onto linear isometry (the radial map). Equivalently every real Banach space has the Mazur-Ulam property. No dimension, separability, reflexivity, smoothness or strict convexity assumptions.

proof_architecture.claim: Reduce to M=0: define cross-radius defect D_q, M=sup|D_q|; D_0=D_1=0, 2-Lipschitz in q, antisymmetric under f<->f^{-1}.
If M>0, pass to completed ultrapowers to get a surjective sphere isometry with global bound |D_q|<=M and an exact attainment D_t(x0,y)=M, 0<t<1.
Fix y,t; build the opposite-endpoint return map g on directions at ty; the extremal set E={s-p=M} is closed, nonempty, g-invariant, and closed under 'shares a support with g(v)'.
Grow conv{v_0..v_n}⊂E by v_{n+1}=g(a_n) with strictly positive a_n; closure C is a nonempty closed bounded convex g-invariant subset of E⊂S_X.
On E, ||g(v)-g(v')||<=γ||v-v'||+scalar terms with γ=(1-M/(1+t))^2<1 (because r=u+M, s=p+M); binning the scalars gives χ(gH)<=γχ(H).
Darbo (re-proved via Schauder via Sperner/Brouwer) gives a fixed point: aligned chords x=ty+pv, z=ty-rv, f(x)=tb+sw, f(z)=tb-uw, s-p=r-u=M, d=p+r=s+u<=2.
Secant estimate: weighted defects at radii t-sh and t+uh cancel the target norm; gives ε/p<=φ(v)<=K<=1-B or B.

Large regime (A>ε or B>ε): strict support signs on both sides (via inverse configuration) + small radial perturbation strictly beat the bound M. Small regime: ε<1/2 and ratio inequalities; convexity of ||y+λv||, ||b+λw|| contradicts ||y-z||=||f(y)-f(z)||.
Hence M=0, so the radial map T is an onto isometry fixing 0; Mazur-Ulam gives linearity; uniqueness by homogeneity.

correctness_audit.verdict: Extraordinary claim (full positive solution of Tingley's problem, open since 1987; quick search finds the general and dim>=3 cases described as open in all accessible sources). The paper is short (544 lines) and I re-derived every step of Sections 3-5 by hand: defect identities, attainment, the return-map equalities r=u+M and ||pv+rg(v)||=p+r, the propagation rule, hull growth, the contraction estimate (exact constants), the secant identity uΔ_x+sΔ_z=MdK (sr-up=Md), the large-ratio sign argument, the inverse relabeling (p',s',r',u')=(u,r,s,p), the small-regime inequalities, and the final convexity contradiction. I found no gap. Trust also rests on a 9.3k-line, sorry/axiom/decide-free Lean development whose comparator statement exactly matches the paper; compile verdict pending from orchestrator.
